title: Action declared in data with no handler is a silent RejectedByState
evidence: AppFlowRuntime::DispatchWithCause returns RejectedByState when handlers_ has no entry (AppFlowRuntime.cpp:163): no diagnostic, appflow.list shows it as live
expected: catalogue 'implemented' flag + DispatchResult::NoHandler + one located diagnostic (R796); sn-liveunhandled1, S

title: appflow.list reports compiled-in actions/transitions/dataTargets, not the runtime's loaded tables
evidence: EditorApplication appflow.list iterates kActionDecls/kTransitions/kDataTargets; selectors and chords now come from the reloaded blob (sn-editorlive1)
expected: list entirely from the runtime's loaded view so an agent never reads stale data

title: Editor row structs repeat one number-field shape per use
evidence: EditorParameterRow, EditorTransformRow, EditorShapeFieldRow and EditorLayerRow.blend* carry the same label/value/upId/downId/valueId set; 4 hand-written markup copies in assets/ui/*.rml (design note section 6)
expected: one shared row type + one number-field base element (sn-uikit1, L)

title: Two UI watchers: document reload (UiDocumentReloader) and HUD viewblob reload (PollHudHotReload)
evidence: UIRenderNode::PollDocumentReload and PollHudHotReload each poll mtimes on their own cadence
expected: one watcher once the HUD view moves to the blob path for every app (design note slice 2)

title: Reload drops uncommitted text of a focused field and may commit it on blur
evidence: UiDocumentReloader restores focus id + caret only; UiInputForwarder commits on blur of an edited field
expected: carry the edited value across the swap or suppress the blur commit during a reload (S)
